meta.title: Power of Federal Constitutional Court and Supreme Court to transfer cases

versions.author: Asif Ali Zardari
versions.subject: Twenty-sixth Amendment 2024-10-21 Asif Ali Zardari
versions.content:
| Title        | Power of Supreme Court to transfer cases |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 21 October 2024 |
| Last Updated | 21 October 2024 |
| Source       | https://www.na.gov.pk/uploads/documents/671f74b8da9e0_263.pdf |
| Amendment 26 | https://www.na.gov.pk/uploads/documents/671f74b8da9e0_263.pdf |

The Supreme Court may, if it considers it expedient to do so in the interest of justice, transfer any case, appeal or other proceedings, pending before any High Court to any other High Court or to itself.

versions.author: Asif Ali Zardari
versions.subject: Twenty-seventh Amendment 2025-11-13 Asif Ali Zardari
versions.content:
| Title        | Power of Federal Constitutional Court and Supreme Court to transfer cases |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 21 October 2024 |
| Last Updated | 13 November 2025 |
| Source       | https://www.na.gov.pk/uploads/documents/671f74b8da9e0_263.pdf |
| Amendment 26 | https://www.na.gov.pk/uploads/documents/671f74b8da9e0_263.pdf |
| Amendment 27 | https://www.senate.gov.pk/uploads/documents/1762598611_995.pdf |

The Federal Constitutional Court or the Supreme Court may, if it considers it expedient in the interest of justice and has the jurisdiction to hear a case, transfer any case, appeal or other proceedings, pending before any High Court to any other High Court or to itself.
